title: Deliverable chunking
spec: Add src/payee/chunk.ts: chunkDeliverable(text, { max = 3800, tag = "" }): string[]. Fold newlines into " ⏎ ", sweep, then cut into pieces of at most max − tag.length chars, each prefixed with tag. Never split inside a surrogate pair. Empty text yields [tag] (one line, so the payer sees something arrived).
done: Chunks re-join to the folded text, every chunk fits the cap with its tag, and no chunk breaks a surrogate pair.
